title: Missing Data Cleaner & DataFrame Combiner Simulator
description: Step-by-step visual trace of detecting missing NaN values with isna(), aggregating counts with sum(), imputing with fillna(), and performing relational merges and concatenations.

steps.title: Instantiate Marks DataFrame with Missing NaN
steps.explanation: Pandas loads numerical data into a 2D tabular structure. Because row 1 has a None value in the numerical 'Mark' column, Pandas casts the missing element to NaN (Not a Number) of float64 type.

steps.title: Generate Missing Value Boolean Mask with .isna()
steps.explanation: marks.isna() inspects each cell individually. Valid entries evaluate to False, while missing entries (NaN) evaluate to True.

steps.title: Aggregate Missing Value Counts with .sum()
steps.explanation: Summing the boolean mask treats True as 1 and False as 0. Column 'ID' has 0 missing values, and column 'Mark' has 1 missing value.

steps.title: Impute Missing Values with .fillna(0)
steps.explanation: fillna(0) replaces the NaN cell at index 1 with 0.0 without dropping Priya's row from the dataset.

steps.title: Instantiate Student Roster DataFrame
steps.explanation: The second data source contains demographic records (ID and Name). Both DataFrames share the primary key column 'ID'.

steps.title: Relational Combination with pd.merge()
steps.explanation: pd.merge() aligns rows by matching values in the 'ID' column (101=Arun=85.0, 102=Priya=0.0, etc.), expanding the DataFrame to shape (4, 3).

steps.title: Stacking Comparison with pd.concat()
steps.explanation: Unlike merge() which matches by key columns, concat() stacks records vertically (axis=0), generating an extended row series with a fresh 0..N-1 index.

steps.title: Final Summary & Verification
steps.explanation: Calculates total student headcount (4) and sums the clean 'Mark' column (85.0 + 0.0 + 78.0 + 92.0 = 255.0).
